title: someone follows a person, Page or venue, and nothing else changes

criteria.text: Following a person, Page or venue writes one row plus its event row in one transaction
criteria.note: Person: `member_follows` + `member.followed` in `withTransaction` (`actions/member/follow.ts`). Page: `group_memberships` + `group.member_joined` (`actions/group/follow.ts`). Venue: `member_saved_searches` + `member.saved_search.created` (`saved-search-create.ts`) [V] Checked: unmarked: `group/follow.test.ts` ("writes an event", mock only); person and venue tests only grep the source text (`actions-t091`, `actions-t109`); none asserts same-transaction.

criteria.text: A follow never grants membership, a role or unlisted read access, checked against every authorization/roster path
criteria.note: Follower row is `role='member'`, `source='soft_via_follow'`; manager checks key on role (`post.ts`, `lifecycle.ts`, `update.ts`, `item/create.ts`) [V sampled]. Partial proofs: `group/follow.test.ts` "grants no role beyond the plain one", `tests/follower-privacy-db.test.ts`, `tests/page-owner-follow-db.test.ts`. No test walks every roster/authz path; no `F065` marker Checked: no (partial, unmarked).

criteria.text: A Member who follows a business and owns no shop still sees Sell offer to start something
criteria.note: `hasActiveBusinessGroup.ts` and `getDraftGroup.ts` count any `group_memberships` row with `left_at is null` on an active business Group; neither filters `relationship`/`role`, so a business follower is read as a seller and `SellCta` routes to /you/sell instead of the start walkthrough [V]. Neither test file mentions follower

criteria.text: Unfollow then re-follow revives the original row
criteria.note: Person: `on conflict ... unfollowed_at = null`; Page: `on conflict ... left_at = null`; venue: `saved-search-restore` clears `removed_at` [V] Checked: unmarked: `group/follow.test.ts` "is idempotent" (mock); person and venue only grep source text.

criteria.text: The following list reads from one table, not three
criteria.note: `get-member-follows.ts` unions `member_follows`, `group_memberships` (source explicit) and `member_saved_searches`; its own header calls them "three substrates" [V]. Test `get-member-follows.test.ts` asserts the union
